verdict.rationale: Recurly documents generic data import/export for populating accounts and records (recurly-docs-11, -15, -23) and a community comment notes the Recurly gateway supports 'credit card portability' similar to Braintree (recurly-comm-9), suggesting some capability to bring in card data from other platforms. However, there is no first-party documentation describing a PCI-compliant migration workflow, spreadsheet-based subscription import, or assurance that migrating live subscriptions is seamless/invisible to customers. Missing for 10: explicit PCI-compliant card-data transfer process, documented spreadsheet/CSV subscription import tooling, and evidence/case studies of migrations occurring without customer disruption.
